name: John Paul Jones
contribution: A British-American naval officer who served in the Continental Navy during the American Revolutionary War.

checks.lead: John Paul Jones (born John Paul; July 6, 1747 – July 18, 1792) was a British-American naval officer who served in the Continental Navy during the American Revolutionary War. Often referred to as the "Father of the American Navy", Jones is regarded by several commentators as one of the greatest naval commanders in the military history of the United States.
